title: Default Swagger test user API retains low-privilege submitted users in a process-lifetime static map
driver: attacker-controlled userId key cardinality and retained UserEntity string fields
dimension: heap object count and key cardinality
retention: static map for process lifetime; deletion requires explicit delete per id
bound: no size cap, TTL, per-user quota, or permission annotation; Shiro login required
default_deployment: swagger.enabled=true and controller is present in default source build
impact_hypothesis: low-privilege repeated POSTs can grow heap and make /test/user/list allocate larger response lists
scope_notes: non-disk; not anonymous; potentially test-only code but enabled in default configuration
